reuse.why: The new action uses the existing category query (getAverageCategories), the shared selection predicate isMonthWideCategory, the sign helper (renamed spendingToBudgetAmount), setBudget, batchMessages and the existing sum-amount sheet cell.

duplication.why: Only the iterate/filter/setBudget loop skeleton is repeated from set3MonthAvg; the selection rule and sign rule are shared rather than copied.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and is registered in app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Focused on the feature; the rename of averageToBudgetAmount to spendingToBudgetAmount touches two existing call sites but is a justified generalisation.

maintainability.why: Small, readable and consistent with the sibling actions; the inline Math.max clamp applies to income categories too and is an unexplained local rule.
